scenarios.name: The first mode adds three green mana when another creature enters
scenarios.ruling: With the first mode chosen the trigger adds {G}{G}{G} to its controller's mana pool; that mana is still unspent when the trigger has finished resolving, and no counters are placed and no card is drawn.

scenarios.name: The second mode puts a +1/+1 counter on every creature you control
scenarios.ruling: With the second mode chosen the trigger puts a +1/+1 counter on each creature its controller controls as it resolves, which includes Galadriel herself and the creature that just entered, but no creature an opponent controls.

script.answer: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.

scenarios.name: The third mode scries 2 and then draws a card when another creature enters
scenarios.ruling: Scrying only reorders the top of the library, so the one card the trigger draws afterwards is the only change to the library: it goes from twenty cards to nineteen and the drawn card is the only card in hand.

scenarios.name: Two creatures entering in the same turn use two different modes
scenarios.ruling: Each creature that enters triggers the ability separately and a mode that has already been chosen this turn cannot be chosen again, so the two triggers do two different things: the first scries and draws, the second puts a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.

script.answer: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
